{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
# Group by patient_id and get the index of the row with max sample_seq
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients
num_patients = len(deduplicated_data)

print(f'Deduplicated patient count: {num_patients}')

# Confirm the result matches the expected unique patient_id count
print(f'Unique patient_ids in deduplicated data: {deduplicated_data["patient_id"].nunique()}')"}
